caption: The drawing features a single wooden armchair placed slightly at an angle, showing three of its four legs, both arms, its backrest, and its seat. The wood is rendered in warm brown tones, with details showing the grain and curvatures of the ornate legs, arms, and back support. The legs and arms have scroll-like, curved designs, and the top of the backrest is shaped with a gentle arch and a central decorative cut-out. The seat of the chair is upholstered in a muted bluish-green fabric, with a small embroidered floral pattern in pink, purple, and green at the center. The drawing is set against a plain beige background, bordered by a thin dark line close to the edges of the paper. In the bottom right corner, the name "FRANCIS LAW DURAND" is written in small capital letters.
title: Chair
